<a id="domain-value"></a>

# value

In [EhOsContract.Domain](domain-dsl.md), section `domain`.

```elixir
value name, type \\ nil
```

A value type: one built-in type with an optional unit, or a set of fields.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| `name` | `atom` | yes |  | The value's name, used as a field type. |
| `type` | `any` |  |  | The built-in type, when the value is not a set of fields. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| `unit` | `atom` |  |  | What a number counts, e.g. `:cents`. |
| `label` | `String.t` |  |  | What the business calls it. |
| `context` | `atom` |  |  | The context the value belongs to. |
| `source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the value comes from in the material. |

Inside it: [`field`](#domain-value-field), [`invariant`](#domain-value-invariant).

<a id="domain-value-field"></a>

## value.field

```elixir
field name, type
```

One field of a value with fields, or of an entity.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| `name` | `atom` | yes |  | The field's name. |
| `type` | `any` | yes |  | A built-in type or a value of this domain. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| `optional` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Whether the field may be absent. |
| `label` | `String.t` |  |  | What the business calls it. |
| `personal` | `atom` |  |  | The field holding the identifier of whose data this is. |
| `subject` | `atom` |  |  | The subject this identifier field identifies. |
| `default` | `any` |  |  | Only in a contract's state. |
| `issued_by` | `atom` |  |  | The external of this domain that gives this value. |


<a id="domain-value-invariant"></a>

## value.invariant

```elixir
invariant name, label
```

What is true of every value of the type, with values that break it and keep it.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| `name` | `atom` | yes |  | The invariant's name, and the name of the function that checks it. |
| `label` | `String.t` | yes |  | The rule, as the business states it. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| `violated_by` | `list(any)` | yes |  | Values that break it, as plain data: each is a test that the check refuses it. |
| `satisfied_by` | `list(any)` | yes |  | Values that keep it, as plain data: each is a test that the check lets it through. |
| `source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the rule comes from in the material. |
